about: The weekly generation-credit budget (plan Wave 2, W2.6), the one spend consent for Codex, Runway, Higgsfield and ElevenLabs: ve dispatch and the ve ledger reserve against it before each dispatch or generation and refuse anything over it. It replaces the per-run --spend-approved flag and the design lock's per-generation yes (ve lock spend). This is the unsigned template: the amounts are Krish's, in his words. Copy it to config/ve/credit-budget.json, fill caps with his numbers and from_week with the first Monday it covers, put his exact words in signed.said, then python scripts/ve.py budget hash prints the record_sha256 his signature carries. No session signs it for him.

units.codex_allowance_points: percent points of the weekly Codex window, as ve ledger allowance_points counts them
units.codex_paid_credits: Codex credits drawn once the weekly window is past ALLOWANCE_CEILING (scripts/velib/cards.py)
